description: This file is a shell script library (`git-mergetool--lib`) that provides functions for sourcing into other scripts to facilitate Git merge tool operations, such as getting merge tool info, initializing tools, and launching merge tools.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Returns the merge tool to use; indicates if it was guessed via return code.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Returns the command line to invoke the merge tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path for the merge tool.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Sources merge tool specific functions for use or override.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Launches a specified merge tool with the appropriate environment variables.
